findings.message: No accountable human owner is recorded for this agent.
findings.recommendation: Assign an owner who answers for what the agent does, or decommission it.

results.title: Every agent has an accountable human owner

findings.message: Agent access has no recorded approval.
findings.recommendation: Route the agent through access approval before its next use.

results.title: Agent access is approved and recertified within 90 days

findings.message: desktop-commander can delete / write confidential data without a human approving each action.
findings.recommendation: Require human confirmation for these actions, or reduce the tool to read-only.

results.title: Privileged agent actions require human approval

findings.message: desktop-commander can execute arbitrary commands on the host without a sandbox.
findings.recommendation: Run the tool in a container or VM with no host credentials mounted, or remove it.

results.title: Code and shell execution is sandboxed
No credentials are hardcoded in agent configuration
Agent credentials are rotated within 90 days

findings.message: No tool usage is logged, so dormant access cannot be identified.
findings.recommendation: Log tool calls per agent so unused access can be found and removed.

results.title: Dormant agent access is removed after 90 days

findings.message: desktop-commander runs @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander without a pinned version, so a new upstream release runs automatically.
findings.recommendation: Pin an exact version (npm/PyPI) or image digest and update it through change control.

results.title: Tool packages are pinned to a version
